acceptanceCriteria: A recorded fixture or reporter produces the request-outcomes record from observed responses and decisive assertions, without author declarations.
Vitest and Go test sessions are either covered or each has a recorded NOT_APPLICABLE reason.
Tests show an undeclared rejection-only Playwright test classified from observed data.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1737 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1101, head d102a537a, LPCV-V0-080..083). Expected: a Playwright fixture records responses and classifies the decisive expect calls into the request-outcomes record automatically. Actual: only author-declared annotations exist; Corvint observes neither responses nor assertions, so an undeclared rejection-only test gets NOT_PRODUCED instead of a verdict. The TypeScript mirror, Vitest and Go test sessions have no equivalent producer.
title: test-validity: rejection anchors depend on author-declared corvint-request-outcomes; no fixture observes responses or decisive assertions
